Name: Farm Stall Lite Recolor
Author: iiAsyra
Description: With Stoel1994's permission, this recolors the lite farm stall to use wood colors from Vibrant Pastoral Recolor and the fabric awning to use colors from the cloth object made using wool in a loom. Recommended to play with Vibrant Pastoral. And of course it had to be foggy out when I took the screenshots... Thanks Weather Wonders.
